optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Predictive Maintenance Engineer, Wind Turbine Fleet Analytics

professionalSummary.text: Seasoned predictive maintenance engineer with three years of experience deploying and operating gearbox and bearing failure models in a live wind turbine fleet analytics platform.
professionalSummary.witness: Deployed four gearbox and bearing failure models into the live scoring service of the fleet analytics platform over three years, releasing each through the platform team's release pipeline under my own release tickets.

professionalSummary.text: Expert in monitoring live alert precision, managing production incidents, coordinating releases, and documenting model limitations.
professionalSummary.witness: Watched live alert precision against confirmed failures in the weekly review with the maintenance planners, and handled the production model incidents in that period, including two sensor feed drop-outs, with incident records in the platform incident log.

experienceHighlights.text: Deployed four gearbox and bearing failure models into the live scoring service, each released via the platform team's pipeline with dedicated release tickets.
experienceHighlights.witness: Deployed four gearbox and bearing failure models into the live scoring service of the fleet analytics platform over three years, releasing each through the platform team's release pipeline under my own release tickets.

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored live alert precision weekly, achieving high precision against confirmed failures.
experienceHighlights.witness: Watched live alert precision against confirmed failures in the weekly review with the maintenance planners.

experienceHighlights.text: Handled production incidents, including two sensor feed drop-outs, with documented incident records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Handled the production model incidents in that period, including two sensor feed drop-outs, with incident records in the platform incident log.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated model releases with the platform team, recording responsibilities in release tickets.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated model releases with the platform team in the release review, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the platform team.

experienceHighlights.text: Built and backtested models on historical sensor and work-order data under a documented evaluation protocol.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and backtested each model on the historical sensor and work-order data under the evaluation protocol agreed with the planners before proposing it for release.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented each model's limitations and hand-over conditions in a model card.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the model card for each model, listing the training data window, the backtest results, the known limitations for turbines without vibration sensors and the hand-over conditions.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Release tickets, weekly precision reviews, and incident records for the four models, available as verifiable work samples.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the release tickets for the four models, the weekly precision review for the last quarter and the incident records for the two sensor feed drop-outs, with the platform incident log identifiers as a verification trail.
